title: Predictive synergy breaks greedy repair
kind: Exact block-3 representation-design census with independent audit
summary: Across 30,856 nonclosed block-3 target cases, greedy fixed-target Shannon repair is globally optimal in 30,852 but fails exactly four times. The first failure requires crossing a zero-immediate-gain distinction that amplifies a later split's predictive value by 13.26x.
takeaway: Closure defects provide an exceptionally strong local repair gradient, but the cheapest sufficient representation can require synergistic bundles of distinctions whose components are not individually predictive.

promotion.idea: Predictive synergy is the first obstruction to greedy representation repair

title: The future-context quotient is the canonical repair target
kind: Universal quotient theorem with exact block-3 safety census
summary: Context substitution induces a unique coarsest sufficient uniform local quotient for any deterministic future label. In the full block-3 ECA census, canonical greedy never encounters a strictly better unsafe edit: all four known failures lie exactly on a zero safety-margin boundary.
takeaway: Greedy regret has a canonical structural certificate: the first refinement that splits a distinction the future-context quotient still merges. Generic synergy is common; fatal synergy requires leaving the quotient-compatible region.

promotion.idea: Future-context equivalence gives the canonical local repair target

title: The local variables arrive before the state does
kind: Exact finite-horizon quotient theorem and block-3 timing census
summary: Finite-horizon future-context quotients refine monotonically and provide one-sided permanent safety certificates. In the exact block-3 census, the final local quotient is discovered before global predictive closure in 23,588 of 30,856 nonclosed cases; every long-memory case with h* >= 10 has d_Q = 1.
takeaway: Representation discovery and state resolution are different dynamical timescales: the local vocabulary of future-relevant distinctions can stabilize almost immediately while global predictive history remains long.

promotion.idea: Local predictive variables can stabilize before the global predictive state

title: The ring hid the third-step witness
kind: Exact local light-cone census with independent witness audit
summary: A wrap-free causal-cone search shows that the four-block ring used in Research030 suppresses real local predictive contexts: 54 rule/target quotients are already underestimated at horizon 2, and exactly four symmetry-related cases contain a local distinction whose first possible witness is horizon 3.
takeaway: Predictive distinctions have their own causal witness horizon, and finite periodic topology can make that horizon look artificially short by removing admissible surrounding contexts.

promotion.idea: Local predictive distinctions have a causal witness horizon

title: A symbolic light cone finds a desert after the third step
kind: Exact symbolic witness automaton, horizon-4–6 census, and congruence certificates
summary: A reduced eight-valued decision automaton replaces explicit light-cone enumeration and extends the complete block-3 ECA causal-witness census through horizon 6. The only new births remain the four symmetry-related horizon-3 events: none occur at horizons 4, 5, or 6. Of 52,712 distinctions still unresolved after horizon 5, 47,352 receive exact all-time target-congruence certificates; 5,360 remain dynamically unresolved.
takeaway: Causal-witness search can be compressed symbolically by many orders of magnitude, and most apparently unresolved distinctions can be separated into proved-permanent versus genuinely reachability-dependent cases without simply searching deeper horizons.

promotion.idea: Causal witness horizons admit symbolic search and all-time congruence certificates

title: The context is in the edges
kind: Exact paired-language invariant theorem and full residual census
summary: A nearest-neighbor invariant of the paired macro dynamics proves permanent invisibility for 5,132 of the 5,360 cases left unresolved by Research032’s all-context congruence, leaving 228. Generated-symbol closure alone adds zero cases.
takeaway: Causal safety can depend on spatial grammar: which hidden paired states may be adjacent can matter more than the set of states alone.

promotion.idea: Causal safety can live in the grammar of spatial relationships
